note: Rules for scan-platform-impact.sh. A rule lists where a documented breaking change shows up in project source. Steps: 2024 (deprecated in 11.5 and 2024.x), 2025 (Pimcore 12 and 2025.x), 2026 (2026.x). Confidence 'documented' means the class, package or option is named in the official upgrade notes; 'heuristic' means a search term chosen by the toolkit that can match unrelated code. Add rules here, not in the script.

rules.title: Twig function pimcore_block (deprecated, removed in 12)
rules.advice: Replace with pimcoreblock or pimcoremanualblock. The old name is deprecated in 11.5 and gone in 12.

rules.title: Twig function pimcore_cache (deprecated, removed in 12)
rules.advice: Replace with pimcorecache. The old name is deprecated in 11.5 and gone in 12.

rules.title: LocaleService and the pimcore.locale service (deprecated)
rules.advice: Use the Symfony locale handling that the upgrade notes name. Check each match: only Pimcore's own LocaleService is affected.

rules.title: DocumentRenderer (deprecated)
rules.advice: Look up the replacement in the upgrade notes for your target before rewriting the call.

rules.title: ResolveUploadTargetEvent context (deprecated in 11.5, removed in 12)
rules.advice: The context property on this event is removed in 12. Read the target from the event's remaining properties.

rules.title: Date editable outputFormat (deprecated, replaced by outputIsoFormat in 12)
rules.advice: The date editable option outputFormat is replaced by outputIsoFormat. The word also appears in unrelated code, so check each match.

rules.title: TinyMCE as the WYSIWYG editor
rules.advice: TinyMCE is for Professional and Enterprise, or through pimcore/tinymce-bundle. Community projects use pimcore/quill-bundle. Check which applies to the licence you hold.

rules.title: doctrine/dbal 3.x constraint (v4 is the supported line)
rules.advice: Pimcore 12 supports doctrine/dbal 4 and drops 3. Check custom SQL code for the v4 API.

rules.title: doctrine/orm 2.x constraint (ORM 3 is supported)
rules.advice: The upgrade notes name doctrine/orm 3. Check entity mappings and the EntityManager setup (default manager with the default connection, or a bundle manager with its own connection, never mixed).

rules.title: getTotalCount( calls (DBAL 4 impact)
rules.advice: The upgrade notes list getTotalCount( under the DBAL 4 changes. Check each call against the new API.

rules.title: gotenberg-php 1.x (only v2 is supported)
rules.advice: The Headless Chrome PDF processor is removed. Web to Print uses gotenberg-php v2 only.

rules.title: Headless Chrome or Chromium PDF processor
rules.advice: The Headless Chrome processor is removed. Move PDF rendering to Gotenberg and update Docker images that install Chromium.

rules.title: enable_authenticator_manager in security config
rules.advice: Remove the key from security.yaml. It no longer exists.

rules.title: Doctrine annotations and annotation routes (doctrine/annotations removed in 12.3)
rules.advice: Use PHP 8 attributes (#[Route(...)]) instead of annotations.

rules.title: Db\Helper::quoteInto and upsert behaviour changes
rules.advice: quoteInto no longer supports the $type argument, and upsert now returns the last insert id. Check each call.

rules.title: Custom tables or migrations using utf8mb4_general_ci
rules.advice: The default collation changed to utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci in 12.0. Mixed collations break joins and comparisons, so review custom tables and migrations.

rules.title: getById called with a non-integer value
rules.advice: getById accepts only int in 12, and ElementInterface::getById takes an extra array $params = []. Cast ids to int and check classes that implement the interface.

rules.title: Data\Link unserialize (removed)
rules.advice: Link::unserialize() is removed. Use the supported way to build the Link value.

rules.title: ClassDefinition Data setIndex with null
rules.advice: setIndex no longer accepts null. Pass a value that matches the declared type.

rules.title: Asset\Image::getThumbnailConfig (removed)
rules.advice: The method is removed from Asset\Image. Check that the match is on an image asset, then use the replacement in the upgrade notes.

rules.title: Data\Password field with removed hash algorithms
rules.advice: Some password hash algorithms are removed. Check which algorithm the field and any custom hashing use.

rules.title: getVersionDependentDatabaseColumnName (removed)
rules.advice: The method is removed. Read the column name another way.

rules.title: Pimcore\Helper\CsvFormulaFormatter (removed)
rules.advice: Use League\Csv\EscapeFormula instead.

rules.title: Tool::getCachedSymfonyEnvironments (removed)
rules.advice: The method is removed. Read the environments from the Symfony kernel or your own config.

rules.title: Mail objects created in custom code (a mail with no sender now throws)
rules.advice: Sending a mail without a sender now throws an exception. Make sure each Mail gets a sender, or that a default sender is configured.

rules.title: Navigation Page::$_defaultPageType (removed)
rules.advice: The property is removed. Set the page type another way.

rules.title: key_value_table.html.twig (removed)
rules.advice: The template is removed. Copy it into the project if it is still needed.

rules.title: Workflow notification and lookup calls
rules.advice: getWorkflowByName now returns ?WorkflowInterface, and the two notification methods take a Transition object. Handle null and pass the transition.

rules.title: Video editable allowedTypes option
rules.advice: An invalid value for allowedTypes now throws. Check the values passed to the video editable.

rules.title: Code that reads assets.customSettings directly
rules.advice: The assets.customSettings column is JSON now. Check direct reads and writes of the column.

rules.title: LowQualityImagePreviewCommand generator option
rules.advice: The command lost its generator option. Remove it from scripts and subclasses.

rules.title: Static bundleManager access (removed)
rules.advice: The static bundle manager layer is removed. Inject the bundle manager service instead.

rules.title: ApplicationLogger filter_priority
rules.advice: The value is now 1 to 8. Check the configured range.

rules.title: JobRunRepositoryInterface implementations
rules.advice: The interface gained an executionContext parameter. Update custom implementations.

rules.title: Custom report adapters
rules.advice: The adapter interface gained getColumnsWithMetadata and getPagination. Implement them (also check classes extending AbstractAdapter).

rules.title: onCreateQueryBuilderCallback (deprecated in 12.2)
rules.advice: Use queryBuilderProcessors instead.

rules.title: EditableDialogBoxConfiguration width and height (deprecated in 12.3.10)
rules.advice: The width and height settings are deprecated. Check each configuration for those two values.

rules.title: Serialize::unserialize without allowed classes (deprecated in 12.3.12)
rules.advice: Pass $allowedClasses explicitly. The default becomes false in 2027.1.

rules.title: pimcore/admin-ui-classic-bundle installed (extra licence for Community users)
rules.advice: Community Edition users of the Classic admin bundle need an additional licence. Read the licence section on the V11 to V12 page; the toolkit does not state terms.

rules.title: Bundles deprecated in 2025.4 (Advanced Object Search, Perspective Editor)
rules.advice: Both are deprecated in 2025.4. Plan a replacement before 2026.

rules.title: Web to Print bundle (Enterprise only from 2025.1)
rules.advice: Web to Print is Enterprise-only from 2025.1. Check the licence you hold.

rules.title: Customer Management, E-Commerce or Web to Print classes (Enterprise only from 2025.1)
rules.advice: Customer Management Framework, E-Commerce Framework, Targeting and Personalization, and Web to Print are Enterprise-only from 2025.1. Check the licence you hold. Namespaces are matched by name only.

rules.title: Classic admin bundle interface or trait
rules.advice: The Classic UI is removed in 2026.1. Rewrite the admin part as a Studio plugin and backend extension (studio-ui-development.md, studio-backend-extension.md).

rules.title: Code that uses the classic admin bundle namespace
rules.advice: Each match depends on the Classic UI bundle. Decide per file: replace with a Studio API, or keep only while you stay on 2025.4.

rules.title: ExtJS or classic admin JavaScript
rules.advice: ExtJS code does not run in Studio. List each file as a rewrite item, one feature at a time.

rules.title: Listeners on classic admin events or classic admin controllers
rules.advice: These hook into the classic admin. Check whether Studio has an event or API for the same job.

rules.title: PHP version below 8.4
rules.advice: 2026.x needs PHP 8.4 or 8.5. Change the Docker image, CI and config.platform.php. Check the 2025.4 requirement on the official system requirements page.

rules.title: Container image or CI job that pins PHP below 8.4
rules.advice: Update the PHP version in the image and in CI to 8.4 or 8.5 for 2026.x.

rules.title: Symfony 6.x constraints
rules.advice: Symfony 7.x is required (7.3 or higher per the upgrade page). Drop explicit 6.x constraints and test on Symfony 7.

rules.title: pimcore-install call without --install-profile
rules.advice: The installer needs --install-profile from 2026.1. Read vendor/bin/pimcore-install --help for the profile names; do not guess one.

rules.title: Symfony Templating EngineInterface
rules.advice: Replace EngineInterface with Twig\Environment and render with the Twig service.

rules.title: Messenger DSN prefix parameter
rules.advice: The parameter now has a trailing separator. Check how each transport DSN is built from it.

rules.title: Custom tables or migrations with another utf8mb4 collation
rules.advice: Pimcore tables and columns use utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci from 2026.1. Review the collation of custom tables, joins and migrations.

rules.title: E-Commerce Framework tracker implementations and price calls
rules.advice: TrackingManagerInterface gained methods, formatPrice() and getCartValue() return ?float, and GA4 replaces Universal Analytics. Add the methods and handle null.

rules.title: GeoIP2 library 2.x
rules.advice: Personalization moves from GeoIP2 2.x to 3.x and the response structure changed. Check custom code that reads the response.

rules.title: Code that parses formatted QuantityValue
rules.advice: The space between value and unit is removed in formatting. Check any code that splits the formatted string.

rules.title: Mail log files in the old folder layout
rules.advice: Mail logs move to YYYY/MM/DD/<log filename>. Run pimcore:migrate:mail-logs-folder-structure or move the files, and fix any custom code that reads the old path.

rules.title: Bundles discontinued in 2026.1 (package found)
rules.advice: These bundles are deprecated and discontinued in 2026.1. Plan a replacement or an own copy per bundle.

rules.title: Classes from discontinued bundles (Glossary, Static Routes, Simple Backend Search, Word Export, XLIFF, SEO)
rules.advice: These bundles are discontinued in 2026.1, except SEO redirects and sitemaps. Package names were not verified, so matching is by namespace. Check each match against the 2026.1 release notes.
